backend/main.mo: Defines the main canister actor and all core domain types for collections, assets, signed copies, users, wallet data, admin stats, and marketplace structures.
backend/migration.mo: Holds legacy type definitions used for state migrations, mirroring older versions of asset, user, and marketplace data models.
feature_evidence.json: Lists feature evidence records mapping features to affected frontend files, components, and test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Contains prewritten summaries of various frontend React files for documentation or tooling use.
frontend/index.html: Basic HTML shell that mounts the React app and loads the main client bundle.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Initializes React Query, Internet Identity, and TanStack Router, wrapping the app with required providers.
frontend/src/components/CertificateDispl: Empty placeholder component file for certificate display functionality.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Renders the site footer with navigation links, copyright info, and a Caffeine.ai attribution link.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: Implements the main navigation header with login/logout, mobile menu, user profile checks, and admin‑only navigation.
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: Layout wrapper that composes the header, page content, and footer.
frontend/src/components/MotorcycleCarous: Empty placeholder file for a motorcycle carousel component.
frontend/src/components/MotorcycleFilter: Empty placeholder file for motorcycle filtering UI.
frontend/src/components/MotorcycleGrid.t: Empty placeholder file for a motorcycle grid display component.
frontend/src/components/PageScaffold.tsx: Layout component that renders a page title, description, optional phase notice, and child content.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages a backend actor based on the current Internet Identity, refreshing dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides Internet Identity authentication context, managing login, logout, and identity persistence.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: React Query hooks for fetching and updating user profiles, admin status, and related backend interactions.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS setup defining theme variables, dark mode overrides, and utility classes.
frontend/src/main.tsx: App entry point initializing React, Internet Identity provider, React Query, and global styles.
frontend/src/pages/AdminDashboardPage.ts: Renders an Admin Dashboard placeholder marked for phase 7 development.
frontend/src/pages/AssetDetailPage.tsx: Renders an Asset Details placeholder page planned for phase 4.
frontend/src/pages/CertificateValidation: Placeholder page for certificate validation functionality planned for phase 3.
Displays a placeholder for collection details planned for phase 3.
frontend/src/pages/CollectionsPage.tsx: Placeholder page for managing asset collections planned for phase 3.
frontend/src/pages/ContactInvitationsPag: Placeholder page for managing contact invitations planned for phase 2.
frontend/src/pages/ContactsPage.tsx: Placeholder page for contact management planned for phase 2.
frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx: Main landing page handling login, profile loading, and profile editing via Internet Identity.
frontend/src/pages/MarketplacePage.tsx: Marketplace placeholder page scheduled for phase 5.
frontend/src/pages/MessagesPage.tsx: Messaging placeholder page planned for phase 6.
frontend/src/pages/MyCollectiblesPage.ts: Placeholder page for viewing owned collectibles planned for phase 4.
frontend/src/pages/MyCollectionPage.tsx: Placeholder page for viewing a user's collection planned for phase 4.
frontend/src/pages/PitchDeckPage.tsx: Placeholder page for generating a pitch deck planned for phase 9.
frontend/src/pages/PrivacyPolicyPage.tsx: Privacy policy placeholder page scheduled for phase 8.
frontend/src/pages/ProfilePage.tsx: Placeholder page for profile management planned for phase 2.
frontend/src/pages/PublicProfilePage.tsx: Placeholder public user profile page planned for phase 2.
frontend/src/pages/SupportPage.tsx: Support and feedback placeholder page planned for phase 8.
frontend/src/pages/UploadPage.tsx: Asset upload placeholder page planned for phase 4.
frontend/src/pages/UserExplorerPage.tsx: User discovery placeholder page planned for phase 2.
frontend/src/pages/UsernameNFTsPage.tsx: Placeholder page for username NFT search and offers planned for phase 2.
frontend/src/pages/WellKnownPage.tsx: Domain verification placeholder page planned for phase 8.
frontend/src/router.tsx: Defines the root layout and all application routes, mapping URL paths to React pages including core, admin, asset, collection, user, and utility views.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Provides helpers for reading URL parameters, persisting them in sessionStorage, and cleaning them from hashes, supporting both query-based and hash-based routing.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures Tailwind theme extensions, colors, animations, fonts, and plugins for the frontend, including custom OKLCH color variables.
project_state.json: Captures the project's current roadmap, architecture notes, known issues, required assets, and feature definitions for the OnlySigned platform.
